reference_build.product: Age of Empires, the Rise of Rome

capture_contract.difficulty_policy: repeat the matrix at every supported difficulty
capture_contract.seed_policy: record every observable seed input and run at least twenty fresh starts per case
capture_contract.isolation: hold scenario, civilization, diplomacy, map and initial resources constant while changing one candidate set at a time
capture_contract.comparison_rule: record selected rule/build behavior and early decisions; do not infer uniform random choice from the directive name

scenes.purpose: Determine the candidate rule set, selection moment, weighting and persistence of the RANDOM rule directive.
Determine whether Random selects a named build list, synthesizes one, or inherits the active DEFAULT profile.
Establish whether repeated starts, save/load and replay consume the same random stream and preserve the selected policy.

completion_rules: Every scene has immutable original artifacts, executable and DAT hashes, and all required metrics.
Every matrix case has at least twenty fresh starts and records the full controlled setup.
A Random policy is accepted only if it predicts a withheld scenario and every deterministic tie/restart case.
Runtime selection is seeded, serialized in canonical state and independent of presentation frame rate.
DEFAULT inheritance and Random resolution receive separate runtime statuses until both are independently proven.
The gate status changes to measured only after automated validation and campaign regression tests pass.
